title: Marginal Limits for Markov-Source Selection Processes
statement: For the bucket-operation process $Y_n$ used for rank selection from strings generated by a Markov source, do the one-dimensional marginals of the appropriately centered and $\sqrt n$-rescaled process converge as $n\to\infty$?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Probability, Trees and Algorithms (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2014/50, pp. 2825--2871](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2014/50)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The primary process-convergence paper proves non-tightness for general Markov sources, but explicitly leaves convergence of the marginals open.

**Sources checked.**

- [Radix selection on Markov sources](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.spa.2018.03.009)
- [Process convergence preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/1605.02352)
